spec.title: API request rate
spec.description: Incoming API requests per second. No traffic is not proof of uptime.

spec.title: Requests without server errors
spec.description: Share of observed requests that did not return HTTP 5xx. No data when there is no traffic; this is not a synthetic availability check.

spec.title: HTTP 5xx rate
spec.description: Requests labeled status=5xx per second. No data means no matching samples, not verified uptime.

spec.title: Provider rate limited

spec.expr: ((sum(rate(dcapal_yahoo_limiter_rejections_total{job="$envs"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(dcapal_yahoo_upstream_rate_limits_total{job="$envs"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0)) + (sum(rate(dcapal_provider_requests_total{job="$envs",provider="kraken",outcome="rate_limited"}[$__rate_interval])) or vector(0))) and on() (count(up{job="$envs"} == 1) > 0)

spec.description: Rate of local Yahoo rejections and upstream HTTP 429 responses, plus Kraken HTTP 429s. Shows 0 only while a selected backend scrape is up; No data means Grafana has no live target/sample.

spec.title: API traffic by response class
spec.description: Requests per second by literal status class (2xx, 4xx, 5xx, other). No data means no samples were scraped.

spec.title: API latency p50 / p95
spec.description: Endpoint latency summary is exported in microseconds. Quantiles are per instance; do not aggregate quantiles across instances.

spec.title: Visitor requests · selected period
spec.description: Count of non-loopback requests recorded by the visitor counter in the selected range; this is request count, not distinct visits.

spec.title: Unique visitors · all time
spec.description: Lifetime unique visitor total, not unique visitors within the selected time range.

spec.title: Provider request rate
spec.description: Provider calls per second by provider, operation and outcome.

spec.title: Provider call duration p50 / p95
spec.description: Duration includes limiter wait. Summary quantiles remain per instance and must not be averaged across instances.

spec.title: Yahoo local limiter pressure
spec.description: p95 wait per backend instance from the limiter-wait summary. The 10 requests/s figure is the app-local configured ceiling, not Yahoo’s published quota.

spec.title: Yahoo local limiter rejections
spec.description: Locally rejected Yahoo calls per second. Distinct from upstream HTTP 429 responses.

spec.title: Portfolio sync stage duration p50 / p95
spec.description: Per-stage latency summary. Quantiles are per instance; inspect the individual instance series.

spec.title: Portfolio sync events
spec.description: Sync event occurrences per minute, excluding new_assets_resolved because that counter increments by the number of assets resolved.

spec.title: Warnings and errors
spec.description: Loki application logs above INFO. Requires the existing Grafana Cloud Loki datasource.

spec.title: Assets resolved · per minute
spec.description: Number of newly resolved assets per minute. This is an asset count, not a sync event count.

spec.title: Yahoo call rate vs app limit · per instance
spec.description: Yahoo calls actually sent upstream per backend instance, reconstructed from non-limiter-rejected provider outcomes plus upstream HTTP 429s. Red threshold is the application-configured local limiter ceiling (10 req/s per instance), not Yahoo’s external quota. No data means no samples or an old backend without the required counters.

spec.expr: sum by (instance) (rate(dcapal_provider_requests_total{job="$envs",provider="yahoo",outcome!="rate_limited"}[$__rate_interval])) + on(instance) (sum by (instance) (rate(dcapal_yahoo_upstream_rate_limits_total{job="$envs"}[$__rate_interval])) or on(instance) (0 * sum by (instance) (rate(dcapal_provider_requests_total{job="$envs",provider="yahoo"}[$__rate_interval]))))
